description: A green-covered table is in front with a pile of bright pink and yellow cloths on the left and a smaller pink cloth being handled near the center. The left hand and right hand pinch the top edges of the small pink cloth as a two-hand object, bring the sides together to fold it into a narrow stack, then the left hand carries it slightly right and sets it down while flattening it with the palm as the right hand releases; afterward, the left hand reaches back to the larger stacked cloths and begins lifting a corner to unfold it.
